epitaph: alejandro martinez diaz · 2026–2123 · madrid · factory worker
lessonsLeft: pay attention to early signs of illness or discomfort, don't ignore them. keep moving and staying active even when it's tough.
keep one close friend through every busy decade. they can be a rock in times of need.
find ways to help others when you can. it enriches your life as much as theirs.
